ValidationRule.description: Para pasar al estado Opportunity accepted se necesita cumplimentar: Deal Id Sytem y Deal Id
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'Opportunity Accepted'), OR( ISBLANK(DES_Deal_Id__c), ISBLANK(DES_Deal_Id_System__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Hold on! To move this Opportunity into the Accepted Stage, you must complete the Deal Id and Deal Id System fields first.
